description: Compute the great-circle distance in kilometres between two coordinate pairs (local, no API call)

from_latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, from -90 to 90, of the starting point.

from_longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, from -180 to 180, of the starting point.

to_latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, from -90 to 90, of the destination point.

to_longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, from -180 to 180, of the destination point.

name: distance_between
